title: Welcome to {{assistantName}}
content:
# Hi, I'm {{assistantName}}

I'm your AI teammate. Tell me the outcome you need, and I can work across your tools to bring the finished result back here.

## Here is what I can deliver

### Images

I can create campaign visuals, product illustrations, social graphics, and ad creative.

![Campaign visual delivered by {{assistantName}}]({{imageUrl}})

`campaign-visual.jpg`

### Presentations

I can turn a rough brief into a structured, designed deck that is ready to present.

![Presentation delivered by {{assistantName}}]({{presentationPreviewUrl}})

[`sproutpop-launch-deck.html`]({{presentationUrl}}) · {{slideCount}} slides

### Videos

I can deliver edited product demos, launch films, explainers, and social cuts with captions.

[Product launch video](<{{videoUrl}}>)

`product-launch-film.mp4` · ready to share

### Automation recommendations

I can review repeatable team work and return a prioritized list of tasks worth automating.

| Priority | Task | Trigger | Deliverable |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Qualify inbound leads | New form response | Enriched CRM record and reply draft |
| 2 | Turn meetings into follow-ups | Call completed | Summary, CRM note, and email draft |
| 3 | Weekly growth review | Monday morning | Metrics brief and anomaly report |

## Why teams get more from {{assistantName}}

A good result does not have to stay inside one person's chat. Save the working process as a shared workflow, and the next teammate starts with what already works.

![One of your teammates works with {{assistantName}} to complete the task. Share the workflow, reuse what works, and improve together.]({{teamLearningDiagramUrl}})

- **Share the workflow, not just the final file.**
- Give every teammate the same starting context.
- Improve one process once, then let the whole team benefit.

## How to work with me as a team

A good answer helps one person. A saved workflow helps everyone who does that job after you.

![Yours: A chat that worked: You and {{assistantName}} get the task right once.; Saved once: A workflow: The process and its context, kept and reusable.; Everyone's: Any teammate: Runs it by name and starts from what already works.; An automation: Runs it on a schedule or a trigger, with nobody asking.]({{sharedWorkflowDiagramUrl}})

One finished chat becomes a workflow the whole team and your schedule start from

[![View the step-by-step guide]({{workflowGuideCoverUrl}})]({{workflowGuideUrl}})

[View the step-by-step guide]({{workflowGuideUrl}}) · [`okou-team-workflow-guide.pptx`]({{workflowGuideDownloadUrl}}) · {{workflowGuideSlideCount}} slides

1. **Run the task with me once.** Describe the outcome you want rather than the steps to get there, and correct me while the work is still in progress. That correction is the part worth keeping.
2. **Save it as a workflow.** Tell me in this same chat: “Create a workflow from what we just finished, and keep the changes I asked for.” I will turn the process into reusable instructions and save it for you.
3. **Change its visibility to Public.** Open the workflow and set **Visibility**. A **Private** workflow stays with you; a **Public** one can be run by anyone in the workspace.
4. **Run it by name.** Type `/` followed by the workflow name in any chat. Add an automation when it should run on a schedule or a trigger instead of on request.

Start with the task your team repeats most often, not the hardest one. A workflow that runs every week is worth more than a clever one that runs once.

## Talk to me in Slack

Most of this work already gets discussed in Slack. Once I am installed there, the answer arrives in the thread instead of in another tab.

![In a channel: You mention {{assistantName}}; {{assistantName}} replies in the thread: The answer stays on your message, so the channel is not flooded and the team can still follow it.; In a direct message: You and {{assistantName}}: One private conversation that keeps its context between tasks.]({{slackConversationsDiagramUrl}})

Where an answer lands in Slack: in the thread on your message, or in a private direct message

**Set it up once**

1. Open **Where {{assistantName}} works** in the left sidebar.
2. On the Slack card, choose **Install to Slack** and approve the permissions. Only workspace admins can install, so ask your admin if you are not one.
3. Everyone else opens the same card and chooses **Connect** to link their own Slack account.

**Then use me like any other teammate**

| In Slack | What I do |
| --- | --- |
| Send me a direct message | We work privately, in one ongoing conversation |
| `@{{assistantName}}` in a channel | I answer in a thread on your message, where the team can follow along |
| `@{{assistantName}}` again inside a thread | I pick that thread back up and keep working in it |
| `/okou` | Opens my command list: connect, switch agent, change model, disconnect |

Two things are worth knowing. In a channel I only reply when I am mentioned, so I stay out of threads I was not asked into. And you can attach a file to a direct message, and I will read it before I answer.

[Set up Slack]({{worksUrl}}) so the workflows you saved above can be started without leaving the channel.

[Invite your teammates]({{inviteUrl}}) so the next workflow you build is already reusable by the people who need it.

[Read the docs]({{docsUrl}}) to learn how shared workflows work.
